articles.title: PHP warns it plans to release 2 emergency patches imminently
articles.content: Unconfirmed report claims PHP2Shell exploit remotely executes code on PHP sites.
articles.titleZh: PHP警告它计划立即发布2个紧急补丁
articles.contentZh: 未经确认的报告声称PHP2Shell利用在PHP站点上远程执行代码。

articles.title: The Internet goes on high alert after discovery of 8 compromised TLS certs
articles.content: Intermediate certs allow anyone to mint web credentials for any Internet server.
articles.titleZh: 在发现8个受损的TLS证书后，互联网进入高警戒状态
articles.contentZh: 中间证书允许任何人为任何Internet服务器铸造Web凭据。

articles.title: Meta Muse exposes users' personal and business secrets when they share conversations
articles.content: Meta is suspending the sharing feature while it investigates its privacy.
articles.titleZh: Meta Muse在用户分享对话时暴露其个人和商业秘密
articles.contentZh: Meta在调查其隐私时将暂停共享功能。

articles.title: PSA: Patch your Plex media server before someone hacks it
articles.content: A researcher says attacks chaining 4 vulnerabilities is hacking unpatched boxes.
articles.titleZh: PSA ：在有人入侵之前修补您的Plex媒体服务器
articles.contentZh: 一位研究人员表示，链接4个漏洞的攻击正在黑客攻击未修补的盒子。

articles.content: YouTube appears to be testing hiding the dislike button on videos, as reported by 9to5Google. articles.title: Judge dismisses Sam Altman’s sister’s sexual abuse lawsuit
articles.content: On Tuesday, US District Judge Zachary Bluestone dismissed the lawsuit Ann Altman filed last year alleging that her brother, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, had sexually abused her throughout her childhood.
